text:
jon: Heads-up: during chart v5.0.0 promote we hit a CRD migration race in eu-west. HelmRelease tried to apply new CRD and webhook timed out, some controllers crashed and we saw 500s. deploy-bot queued a rollback.
deploy-bot: Automated: promotion failed health checks. Suggested actions: rollback to v4.9.8 or pin chart and apply CRD migration job. Reason: CRD webhook timeout during promote.
meera: Confirmed CRD webhook (validating) timed out because webhook service scaled down. This is infra timing, not data model change. We can pin chart version to prevent auto-rollback, apply CRD patch separately, and then resume.
sre-oncall: Agreed with pin+separate CRD rollout. If we rollback we lose the kubeobjects created by the controller; risky. Recommended: annotate HelmRelease to pin chart version and create a one-shot Job to apply CRD and wait for webhook readiness.
paul: Commands: `kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-svc release.redwood/pinned-by=jon release.redwood/pin-reason="crd-migration-webhook-timeout" --overwrite` then `kubectl apply -f crd-migration-job.yaml` and `deployctl rollout resume billing-svc` after CRD job success.
meera: I'll create crd-migration-job.yaml that patches CRD with retry backoff and waits for webhook endpoint healthy. Also will add an annotation `release.redwood/crd-migration-job=280400` for audit.
jon: Authorizing pin: jon. Added release-note entry draft: "pinned v5.0.0 promotion due to CRD webhook timeout during rollout; performing controlled CRD migration; will unpin after webhook healthy."
deploy-bot: Pin detected. Automated rollback suppressed for 90m TTL when `release.redwood/pinned-by` is present. Manual unpin: `kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-svc release.redwood/pinned-by-`. Audit recorded.
sre-oncall: Created INFRA-3310 to track webhook autoscaler and add preflight webhook readiness check to promote pipeline.
paul: After job success run: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/webhook-deploy -n infra && kubectl wait --for=condition=available --timeout=120s deployment/webhook-deploy -n infra` then `kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-svc release.redwood/pinned-by-` to unpin.
meera: Applying job now. Will post results.
jon: Thanks. Once unpinned we'll let deploy-bot continue promote and assemble final release notes mentioning the temporary pin and INFRA ticket.
meera: Job completed successfully at +8m. Webhook healthy. Unpinning now.
deploy-bot: Unpin detected, resuming automated promotion. Promotion completed. Release notes assembled with entry: "Temporary pin during CRD migration due to webhook timeout (INFRA-3310)."
jon: Closing thread. Follow-up: add webhook readiness preflight to CI before next v5.x promote.
